source.description: Here the rival name will come (all in lower case if it is a more than one letter then use '-' as saperator)

is_error.description: This is a field will get decided by the default compiler. If there is any error in the data and got detected by the compiler then teh value wil be true else false

scraped_at_hour.description: Date and time of scrapin - format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:00:00Z. Timezone - UTC

scraped_at_timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the scraping occurred: - format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. Timezone - UTC

scraped_for_timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the scheduled trip scheduled in the application: - format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. Timezone - UTC

country_code.description: country of the rival of the rival

city.description: Pickup or drop-off city of the rival

distance_bucket.description: Here is distance bucket we the type of distance - short, long and medium

route_type.description: the type of route exp: airport or non_airport

pickup_zone.description: The zone of the pickup location

pickup_address.description: Full address of the pickup location

route_distance.description: distance of the route picked by the rival

rival_route_distance.description: distance of the route picked provided the rival

drop_zone.description: The zone of the drop-off location

drop_address.description: Full address of the drop-off location

vehicle_name.description: The name of the vehicle. Exp: Toyota (2014)

vehicle_category.description: The category of the vehicle or category of the service

vehicle_id.description: Ths id of the vehicle or the service/category id

vehicle_capacity.description: The number of passesnger can sit in the vehicle

tag_line.description: The tag line wrritten for the vehicle or the service

is_fixed_fare.description: True if the fare exists as a fixed value, false if it exists as a range

fare_range_string.description: If <> is_fixed_fare <> is false then put the string of fare range here

upfront_fare.description: Final fare displayed if the fare is fixed if not then put the average of the range fare here

min_fare.description: Minimum fare if the fare is given in a range else put the copy of fixed fare here

max_fare.description: Maximum fare if the fare is given in a range else put the copy of fixed fare here

base_fare.description: if the base fare provided by the rival then put here. Above this fare the extra chrgaes will get included

minimum_charge.description: Minimum charge for any ride if exist else null

cancellation_charge.description: Cancellation charge asked by the taxy if exist else null

per_distance_charge.description: Charge per kilometer if exist else null

per_minute_wait_charge.description: Charge per minute applied for any waiting after wait time threshold minute if exist else null

per_minute_ride_charge.description: Charge per minute applied for any ride if exist else null

safe_ride_charge.description: Uber safe ride charge if exist else null

other_charge.description: This is the list of the dictionary where we can define all type of other charges exist in the rival

charge_type.description: Here define the name of the other charge that is not included in the schema of bolt with snake case

value.description: Here define the value of that other charge

other_time.description: This is the list of the dictionary where we can define all type of other time exist in the rival

time_type.description: Here define the name of the other charge that is not included in the schema of bolt with snake case

value.description: Here define the value of that other charge

other_distance.description: This is the list of the dictionary where we can define all type of other distance exist in the rival

distance_type.description: Here define the name of the other charge that is not included in the schema of bolt with snake case

value.description: Here define the value of that other charge

vehicle_eta.description: Vehicle ETA in seconds. This time indicates the time shown by rival in which vehicle will reach to the passesnger (in seconds)

estimated_trip_time.description: Time to reach the destination in seconds once the vehicle is picked / passesnger is boarded on the vehicle / ride started (in seconds)

threshold_wait_time.description: Maximum wait time in seconds until when there will be no extra charge (in seconds)

threshold_cancel_time_by_driver.description: Time in seconds allowed for the driver to cancel the ride (in seconds)

threshold_cancel_time_by_passenger.description: Time in seconds allowed for the rider to cancel the ride (in seconds)

threshold_distance_by_passenger.description: Maximum distance for a pickup point from the user's location

sorry_message.description: Message displayed on the app if the vehicle is not available

client.description: Here the client name will come. It will be in lower case, if has the mutiple letters then do the saperation by underscore(_)

is_surged.description: if field found in the rival then the value will be true or false else will be null

serviceable.description: serviceable will be false only for cases where No rides are available and  vehicle_category will be NA otherwise serviceable will be true

remarks.description: If found remarks for the rival else it will be null
